subject.title: msteams: support Copilot-only streaming without enabling Teams DM streaming

question: Should the MS Teams plugin add a Copilot-specific streaming configuration surface, and which activity metadata should define Copilot versus normal Teams personal chats?
rationale: The code limitation is clear, but the permanent config shape and reliable Copilot detection contract require maintainer intent and live Microsoft 365 activity evidence.

options.title: Approve Copilot-specific streaming after metadata proof
options.body: Add a plugin-owned detector and per-surface config that preserves the existing global default while enabling Copilot-only partial/progress streaming when a live redacted activity sample proves the detector.

options.title: Keep one global streaming mode
options.body: Document that Copilot-only streaming is unsupported for now and avoid growing MS Teams config until Microsoft exposes a stable surface signal.

options.title: Defer pending live activity evidence
options.body: Leave this issue open but blocked until an operator provides sanitized Copilot custom-engine activity metadata that distinguishes it from Teams DMs.

recommendation.title: Approve Copilot-specific streaming after metadata proof
recommendation.body: Add a plugin-owned detector and per-surface config that preserves the existing global default while enabling Copilot-only partial/progress streaming when a live redacted activity sample proves the detector.

likelyOwner.reason: BradGroux is tied to adjacent MS Teams config work and the live Microsoft tracker, making him the best available routing candidate for the config-shape decision.
